name: Zhejiang Tongxing Technology CO., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Tongxing Technology CO., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of refrigeration equipment and related products in China. It provides refrigeration components and products, including applications in light commerce and cold chain logistics, air conditioning components and thermal management for new energy vehicles, and constant temperature control in data centers. In addition, the company offers heat exchangers, refrigeration system piping components, automotive air conditioning pipes, and refrigeration unit modules, as well as contract manufacturing services for refrigeration system piping components.
